review_notes: Hand-maintained. cmegroup.com refuses automated requests (403, 2026-10-02), so figures are transcribed from CME's own notices or reputable reporting of them, each row citing its source. Since 2026-01-13 CME sets metals margins as a percent of contract value (basis 'pct_notional'). Only figures a source states outright are entered; anything unstated stays null. Known gaps: CME raised silver margins on 2026-01-30 and 2026-02-02, but the levels set on those dates aren't confirmed here, nor is anything after 2026-02-06, nor any Micro Silver (SIL) figure. Add a row per contract per effective date as notices are found.

rows.source_note: COMEX 5000 Silver: initial and maintenance raised to 18% from 15%, effective after the close of business Friday 2026-02-06 (Reuters wire via Kitco, 2026-02-06). investingLive's report of the same hike mentions only the initial margin. Third hike since the 2026-01-13 switch to percent-of-value margins.
